# MewvalonEdit markup reference

Fluent extensions declared by the `Aprillz.MewUI.MewvalonEdit` package.

### CompletionList

Receiver: `CompletionList` and derived types (`where T : CompletionList`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `EmptyTemplate(ControlTemplate value)` | `EmptyTemplate` | Sets EmptyTemplate. Built and shown in place of the rows while the list has nothing to offer, so a caller can say why. Nothing is shown while this is null, which is what the original documents. The template is applied to a presenter the list owns, so build against ContentControl. |
| `IsFiltering(bool value = true)` | `IsFiltering` | Sets IsFiltering. If true, the list is filtered to show only matching items, and substrings match. If false, the old behavior: no filtering, search by StartsWith. |
| `OnInsertionRequested(EventHandler<EventArgs> handler)` | `event InsertionRequested` | Subscribes handler to InsertionRequested. Raised when the list indicates that the user has chosen an entry to be completed. |
| `OnSelectionChanged(EventHandler handler)` | `event SelectionChanged` | Subscribes handler to SelectionChanged. Occurs when SelectedItem changes. |
| `SelectedItem(ICompletionData value)` | `SelectedItem` | Sets SelectedItem. |

### TextEditor

Receiver: `TextEditor` and derived types (`where T : TextEditor`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `CaretOffset(int value)` | `CaretOffset` | Sets the caret position as a character index into the document. |
| `Document(TextDocument value)` | `Document` | Sets the document being edited; never null. |
| `Encoding(Encoding value)` | `Encoding` | Sets the encoding Save writes with; null means UTF-8 without a byte order mark. |
| `IndentationStrategy(IIndentationStrategy value)` | `IndentationStrategy` | Sets the strategy that indents a new line and reindents lines for IndentSelection; null disables both, and the default is DefaultIndentationStrategy. |
| `IsModified(bool value = true)` | `IsModified` | Sets whether the document has changed since it was last marked unmodified. |
| `IsReadOnly(bool value = true)` | `IsReadOnly` | Sets whether the text is read-only; the default is false. |
| `LineNumbersForeground(Color? value)` | `LineNumbersForeground` | Sets the color of the line numbers; null follows the theme. |
| `OnDocumentChanged(EventHandler handler)` | `event DocumentChanged` | Subscribes handler to DocumentChanged. Occurs when Document was replaced, not when its content changed. |
| `OnIsModifiedChanged(EventHandler handler)` | `event IsModifiedChanged` | Subscribes handler to IsModifiedChanged. Occurs after IsModified changed. |
| `OnOptionChanged(EventHandler<MewProperty> handler)` | `event OptionChanged` | Subscribes handler to OptionChanged. Occurs when an option changed, carrying the option that did. |
| `OnTextChanged(EventHandler handler)` | `event TextChanged` | Subscribes handler to TextChanged. Occurs when the document text changed, including when the document was replaced. |
| `ShowLineNumbers(bool value = true)` | `ShowLineNumbers` | Sets whether the line number margin is shown; the default is false. |
| `SyntaxHighlighting(IHighlightingDefinition value)` | `SyntaxHighlighting` | Sets the highlighting definition that colors the text; null shows plain text. |
| `Text(string value)` | `Text` | Sets the document text. |
| `VerticalScrollBarVisibility(ScrollBarVisibility value)` | `VerticalScrollBarVisibility` | Sets when the vertical scrollbar is shown; the default is Auto, and the text scrolls either way. |
| `WordWrap(bool value = true)` | `WordWrap` | Sets whether lines wrap at the viewport width; the default is false. |

Receiver: `FoldingMargin`.
